# `Tea.Terminal.Color`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Tea.Terminal.Color — the first-class terminal colour palette.

`Color` (spelled `Terminal.Color` in a view) is a closed sum over the
sixteen named ANSI colours plus `default` (the terminal's own foreground or
background). The set is fixed: an invalid colour has no representation, so a
view can never name a colour the terminal cannot render.

Both the Tui view surface (`Ipe.Tea.Tui.Ui.color` / `bg`) and the Cli line
surface (`Ipe.Tea.Cli.Ui.color` / `bg`) accept this palette. Truecolour
(`Ipe.Tea.Tui.Ui.rgb` / `rgba`) remains available as a separate path for
terminals that support it; the palette is the portable, first-class surface.

## `black`

```ipe
black : Color
```

ANSI black (SGR foreground 30, background 40).

## `rgb`

```ipe
rgb : Int -> Int -> Int -> Color
```

`rgb r g b` — a 24-bit truecolour from red/green/blue channels (0-255).
Rendered on terminals that support truecolour; the named palette above is the
portable path.

## `rgba`

```ipe
rgba : Int -> Int -> Int -> Float -> Color
```

`rgba r g b a` — a 24-bit truecolour with an alpha channel (0..1).
